description: Allowlist for check_test_degeneracy.py. Each entry justifies why a file without a degeneracy guard is acceptable.

entries.justification: Pure arithmetic: frame timing math (ms→frames). Input is an integer, output is a different integer by definition. No signal path where output==input is possible.
Pure geometry math: stride/offset calculations. Output is a layout struct computed from dimensions. Not a signal transform — cannot be degenerate.
Protocol state machine: tests command parsing and state transitions. Input is a byte sequence, output is a decoded command enum. Not a signal transform.
String parser: parses audio status lines into integers. Input is text, output is a number — structurally different types, cannot be identity.
Bit-packing: converts (R,G,B) triplets to packed uint16. Input and output are different types/widths. Not a signal filter.
Network protocol: tests PMS timeline request/response sequencing. Input is a media state, output is HTTP messages. Different domains.
URL resolver: tests URI decoding, path resolution, redirect chains. Input is a URL string, output is a different URL string. Not a signal path.
UI overlay rendering: tests that overlay pixels are painted. Comparison is size/position, not signal integrity. Not a decode transform.
Ring buffer mechanics: tests begin/end/wrap of a circular reader. Output is ControlResult enum + byte position, not reconstructed pixels.
Hardware integration smoke test (on-device only). Comparison is a log grep for error strings, not a signal comparison. Degeneracy N/A.
